record.summary: Trial measures that set up ethics review of science and technology activities involving human participants or laboratory animals, or posing ethics risks to life and health, the environment or public order. Units doing life-science, medical or AI work in ethically sensitive areas must set up ethics committees, which check among other things that algorithms, models and systems follow fairness, justice, transparency, reliability and controllability principles. Listed higher-risk activities need expert re-review, among them human-machine fusion systems, algorithms able to mobilise public opinion, and highly autonomous automated decision systems in settings with safety or health risks.
record.notes: Issued by the Ministry of Science and Technology and nine other bodies with a notice of 7 Sept 2023, after approval by the Central Science and Technology Commission; published on the MOST website on 8 Oct 2023 and in force from 1 Dec 2023 (Art. 56). Activities on the list in the annex, which MOST publishes and adjusts, need expert re-review organised by provincial or sectoral authorities after the unit's initial review (Arts. 25-34). Units register their ethics committees and listed activities on a national platform and report each year (Arts. 43-45). Emergency reviews are generally completed within 72 hours (Art. 36). Low-risk activities can use a simplified procedure (Art. 22).

（一）科技活动伦理风险发生的可能性和程度不高于最低风险；

judgment.status_reasoning: Art. 56 makes the Measures effective from 1 Dec 2023, which has passed (today 18 Oct 2026). The MOST page (copy of 11 Oct 2026) marks the document as valid (有效), and nothing stored shows an amendment, repeal or replacement; the AI-specific ethics measures of March 2026 (CN-15) build on it rather than replace it. 'In force' stands.
judgment.date_reasoning: date_published 2023-09-07 is the drafting date (成文日期) and the date under the issuing bodies' names; MOST published it on 8 Oct 2023 (notes). date_in_force 2023-12-01 is Art. 56.
judgment.scope_reasoning: Not AI-specific: a cross-sector ethics review regime, included with its existing scope_note for its AI-related review list (Art. 4, Art. 15(5), annex items 5-7) and as the parent framework of CN-15; the scope_note is kept.
judgment.legal_force_reasoning: Issued by ten bodies with an instruction to comply (请遵照实施) and penalty provisions (Arts. 47-48); 'Binding' kept.
